وَخْوَاخٌ A fat and fleshy man, whose flesh shakes: (L:) having a flaccid belly, and dilated skin; (L, K;) as also بَخْبَاخٌ: (L:) lazy; (L, K;) unwilling to work: (L:) lazy or heavy: (L:) weak: (S, K:) a weak coward: (L:) ad venerum impotens; (L, K;) as also بَخْبَاخٌ and ذَوْذَخٌ: (L:) qui se polluit, aut concacat, tempore coitus; as also نخباخ and ذوذخ. (IAar.) ―
-b2- Anything flaccid: (L:) and particularly a flaccid date: (K:) or a date having a flaccid skin: (L:) or a date having no sweetness nor taste. (IAar.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
